summary_1line: During celebratory gambling, Virata strikes the disguised Yudhishthira for praising Vrihannala, while Uttara later rebukes his father and urges him to appease the Brahmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Virata angrily hurls a dice that strikes Yudhishthira in the face, blood flowing as the calm Pandava catches it in his hands.
Draupadi quickly holds a golden vessel beneath Yudhishthira’s nose, catching the blood while he sits silently in the royal court.
Uttara enters the hall and sees the disguised Yudhishthira sitting bloodied on the ground beside Sairindhri, confronting his father in shock.
